Spurs cornerstone of two decades of quiet contention.

How Tim Duncan connects

  • Faction: San Antonio Spurs — Tim Duncan was the cornerstone of the San Antonio Spurs.
  • Event: NBA draft — Tim Duncan's draft landing in San Antonio built two decades of contention.

What is Tim Duncan?

Tim Duncan, the Big Fundamental, won five NBA championships with the San Antonio Spurs and made Gregg Popovich's system the anti-spectacle dynasty.
